title: Composite Pattern
overview: Compose objects into tree structures to represent part-whole hierarchies, letting clients treat individual objects and compositions uniformly.
useCases: You want to treat individual objects and groups of objects uniformly via a shared interface
Clients should work with single items and collections interchangeably
Representing tree-like structures such as file systems, UI component hierarchies, or organisational charts
exampleUses: A menu system where both individual menu items and submenus implement a render() method so the UI draws them the same way
An expression evaluator where literals and compound expressions (add, multiply) all implement evaluate(), enabling recursive calculation
A build system where individual tasks and task groups both implement execute(), so the runner doesn't distinguish between them
